GANGSTAS PARADISE (Sleeper) — Herbert/Hampton open Friday in São Paulo; Higgins, Flowers and Downs all trending to play — lineup set
Do now: nothing — lineup is set
Locks next 24h: none — first kickoff is Fri 5:00 PM PT (Herbert, Hampton vs KC, São Paulo)
Lineup, by kickoff: Herbert (QB) and Hampton (RB), Fri 5:00 PM PT vs KC — no news, both in. Chase Brown (RB), Higgins (WR, Q — heel contusion, limited practice, Taylor calls it minor), Flowers (WR, Q — lower-body, trending back to full practice), Strange (TE), Tuten (FLEX RB, Q — lingering illness tag, JAX's real risk is the Rodriguez/Allen committee behind him not his health), Downs (FLEX WR, Q — calf, "very minor," trending toward off the report), and JAX DEF all kick off Sun 10:00 AM PT. Aubrey (K) closes it out Sun 5:20 PM PT @ NYG. If Higgins is out, start Diggs. If Flowers is out, start Diggs. If Downs is out, start Diggs; if two of Higgins/Flowers/Downs are out, Diggs then Michael Wilson. If Tuten is out, start Woody Marks.

GAME OF THROWS (Yahoo) — 39% underdog vs GIBBBBBYYYY; Stafford opens Thursday in Melbourne, Etienne now the clean lead with Kamara out — lineup set
Do now: nothing — lineup is set
Locks next 24h: none — first kickoff is Wed 5:20 PM PT (Myers vs NE)
Lineup, by kickoff: Myers (K), Wed 5:20 PM PT vs NE — no news, in. Stafford (QB) and 49ers DEF, Thu 5:35 PM PT @ LAR in Melbourne — Stafford a full camp participant, no news; 49ers DEF stays your weakest starter (4.32 proj) but nothing actionable. Chase Brown (RB), Etienne (RB), Judkins (W/R/T), G. Wilson (WR) and P. Washington (WR) all kick off Sun 10:00 AM PT — Etienne is the clean NO lead now that Kamara (MCL) is confirmed out about a month; Judkins is entrenched as Cleveland's RB1 over Sampson/Sanders; Brown, G. Wilson, P. Washington have no news. Pickens (WR) and Likely (TE) close it out Sun 5:20 PM PT @ NYG / vs DAL — no news, both in. No Qs on this roster, no contingencies needed.

FYI: Chase Brown starts for you in both leagues; your JAX DEF (Sleeper) and Judkins' Browns (Yahoo) collide in the same CLE@JAX game; Yahoo opp Arshdeep still carries three Qs (Jeanty-ankle, HC optimistic; Nabers-knee, won't commit to Week 1; LaPorta-hip, back to full practice) and Sleeper opp AdufortheWin84's Henderson (ankle) and Pittman (hamstring, now on PIT) are both trending to play.
